title: Juicy Salt Baked Algerian Pork Tenderloin Roast
description: A low-calorie-friendly Algerian dish featuring pork tenderloin, salt-bake, and a blend of bitter and chewy flavors, perfect for a date night dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, mix together kosher salt, brown sugar, smoked paprika, ground cumin, and black pepper
Place the pork tenderloin in a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper
Rub the salt mixture all over the pork tenderloin, making sure to coat it evenly
Place the chopped dates and parsley on top of the pork tenderloin
Cover the bamboo steamer with a lid and bake for 25 minutes
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving
